description:
Dear Colleagues,

We are pleased to announce that Dr. Maya Patel (maya.patel@example.com), a senior researcher at the Global Climate Institute, will lead a two‑hour workshop titled **“AI‑Driven Climate Modeling: From Data to Decision‑Making”** at the **International Conference on Sustainable Technologies**, which runs from September 21 to September 24, 2024. Dr. Patel’s extensive background—authoring more than 50 peer‑reviewed papers at the intersection of artificial intelligence and environmental modeling—will guide participants through the practical application of modern AI techniques to climate data. The session’s abstract emphasizes hands‑on work with real‑world datasets, building neural‑network models, and mastering best practices for model interpretation and deployment. The workshop falls under the primary topic **Artificial Intelligence**, with secondary emphasis on **Climate Science**, **Data Visualization**, and **Environmental Policy**.

The intermediate‑level workshop is designed for data scientists, environmental engineers, policy analysts, and research scientists. Attendees will leave with a hands‑on understanding of building and interpreting AI models for climate applications, as well as a toolbox of reproducible workflows. To fully participate, please ensure the following software is installed on your workstation: **Python 3.10+**, **TensorFlow 2.12**, **Docker**, **Git**, and **JupyterLab**. We look forward to your participation and to advancing sustainable technologies together.
